thread:
ana: Quick heads-up — opening a docs PR to migrate Console/Observability pages: tracing hooks, dashboard cost/latency breakdowns, and examples. PR will include compact dashboard presets YAML, Go + Ruby tracing snippets, and a link-sweep for orphaned samples. Target: merge by end of week if no blockers.

sasha: tagging @matt and @jen. I can take link-sweep and dashboard schema review. Will run smoke after snippets land.

matt: I can own the dashboard YAML and the cost/latency JSON example. Draft presets (tiny):

```
presets:
  - id: kv-prefetch-cost
    title: "KV Prefetch: Cost vs Latency"
    widgets:
      - type: heatmap
        metric: requests.per_minute
      - type: timeseries
        metric: cost.per_token
        aggregate: p95
```

matt: Will note sequence-length distribution effects on p95.

jen: I can do Go + Ruby snippets for tracing hook + SDK examples. Do we include sync only or also streaming & function-calls? Also, are we switching to the new trace_key param names?

ana: include both sync and streaming minimal examples. Use "trace_key" and add compatibility note for older SDKs.

jen: Go snippet for the PR (trimmed):

```go
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
ctx := context.Background()
span := client.Tracing().Start(ctx, "create_embedding")
resp, _ := client.Embeddings().Create(ctx, "hello world")
span.End()
```

jen: I'll also add a short Ruby example and cross-link to the samples repo.

docs-bot: PR created — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123 by ana. Labels: docs, obsv, needs-review.

matt: noted. I'll update broken URL and add migration paragraph: key renames cost_bucket -> cost_range, traceId -> trace_id.

ana: yes, embed excerpt + link. Also add a tiny e2e smoke GH Action: linter -> import-check -> deploy-preview to validate console import and examples render.

ana: Assigning owners: sasha = link-sweep + QA, matt = dashboard YAML + import JSON, jen = SDK snippets + examples. I'll shepherd and do final migration guide pass. Please review by Thursday EOD.
